_meta.description: Rack component catalog for the nicet_agent OneRack-style selector. Beam capacities are per PAIR of beams, static load, including impact, per ANSI/RMI MH16.1. Frame capacities are per single upright frame, governed by max unsupported length (floor to top of lowest beam, or max beam spacing).
_meta.units: inches for dimensions, pounds (lb) for capacities

confidence_levels.published: Transcribed directly from the manufacturer's published load chart (cited).
confidence_levels.representative: Representative values anchored on published data points; CONFIRM against the manufacturer's current load tables before use.

_meta.IMPORTANT: This catalog is a triage aid. Final component selection, capacity, and seismic adequacy must be confirmed against the manufacturer's current published load tables and reviewed by a licensed PE.

beams.source: Anchored on Interlake published points (e.g. 96in x 2.75in 15ga ~2,440 lb/pair; ~108in ~5,380 lb). Confirm at https://www.interlakemecalux.com/beam-load-capacities
beams.note: Roll-formed teardrop, L/180 deflection, per RMI ANSI MH16.1. Capacities per pair.

beams.source: SpaceRAK Roll Formed Step Beams Capacity Chart (9/13/19), per ANSI MH16.1-2012. https://www.heartlandsteel.com/assets/images/pdfs/spacerak/SpaceRAK_RollFormedBeamsCapacityChart.pdf
beams.note: 3in-4.625in = 3-pin/6in connectors; 5in-6.5in = 4-pin/8in connectors. Capacities per pair, include impact, L/180.

beams.source: Anchored on Hannibal published points (120in x 5in ~5,333 lb/pair; 144in x 4.5in ~3,103 lb/pair). Confirm against Hannibal Industries current load tables.
beams.note: Hannibal Industries is a Nucor company. Roll-formed teardrop. Capacities per pair.

frames.source: Representative roll-formed upright capacities; CONFIRM against Interlake frame load tables. Capacity governed by max unsupported length (floor to first beam / max beam spacing).
frames.note: Capacity per single frame. Default depths 42in / 48in.

frames.source: SpaceRAK Structural Channel Frames Capacity Chart (9/24/18), per 2002 RMI/AISI. https://heartlandsteel.com/assets/images/pdfs/spacerak/SpaceRAK_StructuralChannelFramesCapacityChart.pdf
frames.note: Capacity per single frame, by max unsupported length (floor to top of lowest beam, or max beam spacing). H:D ratio <= 6:1 for single-row.

frames.source: Representative roll-formed upright capacities; CONFIRM against Hannibal Industries current frame load tables.
frames.note: Hannibal Industries is a Nucor company. Capacity per single frame. Default depths 42in / 48in.
